pr_title: [BugFix] allocate MTP hidden buffer only for speculative decoding
source_quote: Please check whether both mtp and dspark use this buffer?

correspondence.patch_snippet: 评后sha d77311b 体现修改

rule.description: 当资源仅适用于某个特定子场景时，条件判断应精确匹配该子场景，而非仅检查外层条件。
checkpoints: 识别条件判断中是否只检查了外层条件
确认资源是否只在特定子场景下使用
如果是，应添加更精确的子条件

antipattern.code:
# vllm_ascend/models/deepseek_v4/model.py
self._mtp_hidden_buffer = (
    torch.empty(
        vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens,
        hc_dim,
        dtype=vllm_config.model_config.dtype,
        device=self.device,
    )
    if vllm_config.speculative_config is not None
    else None
)

pattern.code:
# vllm_ascend/models/deepseek_v4/model.py
spec_config = vllm_config.speculative_config
self._mtp_hidden_buffer = (
    torch.empty(
        vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens,
        hc_dim,
        dtype=vllm_config.model_config.dtype,
        device=self.device,
    )
    if spec_config is not None and spec_config.method == "mtp"
    else None
)
